hooks.name: QRoker Spec start evidence
hooks.description: Save a minimal local timestamp and commit before Spec execution; no prompts or source contents.

hooks.name: QRoker destructive shell guard
hooks.description: Optional extra protection for recognized destructive shell operations. Disabled until locally tested; Kiro permissions remain the primary security boundary.

hooks.name: QRoker fast TypeScript syntax check
hooks.description: Run the established game typecheck at most once every 60 seconds after saved src/game TypeScript files; do not modify code.

hooks.name: QRoker agent turn mobile notification
hooks.description: Optional generic ntfy alert when an agent response ends, throttled and deduplicated against Spec notifications.
